_comment: Office layout under the real constraints: near and mid within 3 m,
far within 7 m and mounted high. Far sits at 4.5 m, not 7, because a
15 cm tag at 7 m spans 13 px on CamD and 8 px on CamA - undetectable.
At 4.5 m it spans 20.6 px on CamD, serving exactly the Double Sphere
camera that needs the depth diversity. Axis: y up, -z forward. rot is
